license_scope: The authored selection, modelling annotations and source code. No license is claimed or granted over third-party product pages, photographs, logos or marketing copy.
scope: A manually curated starting catalogue of single-origin coffees from US roasters, not an exhaustive or live inventory.
extraction_method: Manual transcription of short factual product descriptors from the linked primary roaster listings; no bulk scraping, copied descriptions or images.

transformed_fields.altitude_m: Published metres, or an explicitly annotated feet-to-metres unit conversion.
transformed_fields.altitude_range_m: Published range endpoints in metres, with feet conversions annotated. coffeeToBeanInput uses an explicitly labelled midpoint estimate.
transformed_fields.process: Mapping to a supported process enum when the published label matches; unsupported wet-hulled remains null.

estimated_fields.arabica_fraction: Inferred from listed varieties and origin; no species assay was provided.
estimated_fields.roast_level: An editable model starting estimate from the roaster label. Not a color-to-chemistry conversion.

uncertainty: Roaster descriptions are source-reported facts, not independently measured by Puckworks.
Availability is a dated snapshot. Returning product names can represent different harvests, lots or roast profiles.
A single-origin farm or cooperative lot may contain multiple cultivars; cultivar proportions are not invented.
Roast color retains the reported scale, instrument and sample preparation; different measurement conventions are not interchangeable.
Catalogue presets are starting assumptions and do not establish real-world shot prediction accuracy.
